_readme: Failures we already know about, so the daily report can tell them from new breakage. Each entry lists substrings of the test names that show the bug. Tests for these are marked known-bug in code (see README.md) so pull-request CI skips them. When the fix lands, delete the entry and the known-bug marker in the same change.

LONGCALL-URGENT.title: Long-call notice isn't urgent after a money app when pause cards are off (TripwireEngine.kt:117 returns before noting the app)

S-17.title: Helpers can make risky changes (numbers, trusted apps, turning protection off, remote unlock) without the parent's approval

SEC-3-NOTICE.title: Helpers aren't told when another helper is approved, declined or removed (SECURITY.md §3/§6)

EVENT-KEYS.title: Event data with undocumented keys (a phone number, a message) is accepted by the rules (firestore.rules:74)

COPY-F4.title: Pause-card push wording differs from SPEC F4 (copy.ts:137,147)
tests: [known bug copy differs from SPEC F4]

TRIPWIRE-MEMORY.title: The 30-minute window after an unknown call lives only in memory (TripwireEngine.kt:44), so no pause card if Android kills Guardian or the phone restarts after the call

BOOT-API29.title: On Android 10 the service isn't back within 90 s of a restart (fine on Android 16); BOOT_COMPLETED start in Receivers.kt:31

HOME-MEMORY.title: Home screen uses 170-210 MB (PSS) against the 150 MB budget in GM-PERF-007

S-03.title: The notification's "Pause for 1 hour" skips the lock code (Receivers.kt:48)

S-13.title: Family calls arm pause cards' contact check even when Guardian isn't the call screener (GuardianBrain.kt:38)

S-05.title: The notification keeps saying paused after the pause ends (GuardianService.kt:72 distinctUntilChanged)

S-02.title: Transparency and safe-word screens aren't FLAG_SECURE, so screen sharing can show them

S-11.title: At Locked without overlay permission or the home role, a code screen only posts a notification (CardLauncher.kt:26)

S-06.title: Solo mode lists events under "What your family was told" (LocalStore.kt:62 records with no family; TransparencyScreen.kt:127 ignores paired)

S-07.title: Solo Help screen has only Back (HelpActivity HelpContent)

A11Y-64DP.title: Several buttons, switches and fields are 48-57 dp; SPEC bar 8 asks for 64 dp

REMOVE-PERMISSION.title: "Remove <app>" on the remote-control warning flashes Android's uninstaller, which closes at once: Guardian doesn't declare REQUEST_DELETE_PACKAGES (AndroidManifest.xml; Launch.kt:45 sends ACTION_DELETE)
